study.question: Does preserving the association of adjacent-event elapsed gap and the newer endpoint absolute recency improve prediction beyond their separate margins, under the same visible 128-event history?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the source-checked direct_lifted gap branch pools absolute recency out of N,C,B and product-recurrence gap counts. Existing action/age histograms describe events, not gap/age association. Gap additions raised one-seed AUC from about .62188 to .63000, but marginalizing recurrence/gap association was nearly neutral in round17; packet grouping in round21 reached .630425 versus incumbent .630432 with higher cost, so timestamp-unit replacement is not established useful. Mechanism hypothesis: an explicit 4x4 gap-by-newer-endpoint-age count table exposes recent versus older bursts hidden by this pooling. This is an observed representational omission, not established predictive insufficiency. Retain singleton support to separate this question from tied-time recovery.

study.proposed_difference: Append a bias-free 16->16->1 ReLU head, last weight zero, reading only total eligible adjacent-edge counts H[gap,endpoint_age]. Joint cell reads H. Marginal cell reads row(H)*col(H)/sum(H), preserving every raw gap and age margin while deleting their association. Gap-only repeats row(H)/4 over four age bins, preserving gap counts but omitting age distribution. Zero cell supplies all zeros. All variants allocate identical 272 extra parameters and compute all views; each is standalone. Only the new input selection changes. Endpoint recency is relative to current impression, not calendar time, and adjacency remains on the host prefix subsequence. No category/brand recurrence channels or additional events are added.
predictions: Before fitting, raw joint and marginal tables preserve each gap/age margin and total edge count; they can differ on realizable positive-age histories. Gap-only has identical gap margins, and zero head remains identically zero.
If gap/age association is useful, timing_joint exceeds timing_marginal in full-population validation AUC under matched seed/cost; an isolated positive seed remains preliminary.

If only separate edge recency distribution matters, timing_marginal may beat timing_gap_only while joint does not beat marginal. If only extra readout capacity or different gap scaling matters, gap_only may match joint.

Host diagnostics should show count/oracle agreement, reordering/padding invariance, correct empty/singleton/tie exclusions, finite inputs/logits, and nonzero joint-vs-marginal feature separation on supported histories; these are implementation checks, not causal benefit.
No speed gain predicted: extra sorting and readout add cost. Compare measured wall/GPU/memory/throughput and paired-seed variation, not parameters alone.

Preflight evidence is limited to syntax/source inspection and806 pure-Python scalar-oracle histories; no Torch forward/gradient training has executed locally. Host diagnostics and full validation are required before accepting runtime correctness or predictive benefit. Witness equality concerns the new branch raw margins and inherited gap features, not equality of every parent event-age embedding.
falsifiers: Material raw-margin, dense-oracle, support or invariance errors invalidate the intended contrast and require correction before interpreting scores.
Joint failing to improve on marginal weakens this implementation at fixed bins/head/training; it does not refute every gap/age mechanism.
Joint and marginal both failing against zero or incumbent provides no performance support for this added branch.
Gap-only matching joint or marginal matching joint disallows attributing an improvement specifically to empirical gap/age association.
A timing witness with equal raw margins must produce equal marginal/gap-only representations and distinct joint representations; failure falsifies the claimed information distinction.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed model selection, many previous trials and kernel/reduction noise may explain small differences; validation is repeatedly used and no test feedback is authorized.
Raw-marginal preservation does not preserve post-log sums, feature norms, sparsity or effective optimization; extra head and gap-only controls reduce but do not eliminate these confounds.
The 4x4 table encodes burst geometry and dependence on truncation/excluded ties, not a causal user-intent variable; gaps can bridge filtered events.
Age bins and newer-endpoint choice may be too coarse or wrong for useful signal; head optimization and zero-init can underfit.
Unknown static snapshot as-of dates, 128-event truncation, exposure prevalence, and category/brand rather than item identity limit transfer.
Inherited event histograms and recency embeddings may already predict this information; an explicit readout could help accessibility without adding unique information to all parent branches.
